discordResponseCodes.name: OK
discordResponseCodes.description: Request succeeded and Discord returned data.

discordResponseCodes.name: No Content
discordResponseCodes.description: Webhook sent successfully. This is the normal success response when Discord does not return the created message.

discordResponseCodes.name: Bad Request
discordResponseCodes.description: The request is invalid. This can be caused by malformed JSON, an invalid embed structure, or invalid field values.

discordResponseCodes.name: Forbidden
discordResponseCodes.description: Discord understood the request but will not allow it. This is usually a permissions or access issue.

discordResponseCodes.name: Not Found
discordResponseCodes.description: The webhook does not exist, the URL or token is incorrect, or the webhook was deleted.

discordResponseCodes.name: Method Not Allowed
discordResponseCodes.description: The wrong HTTP method was used, such as GET when Discord expects POST.

discordResponseCodes.name: Payload Too Large
discordResponseCodes.description: The message, attachment, or request is too large.

discordResponseCodes.name: Unsupported Media Type
discordResponseCodes.description: The Content-Type or request encoding is incorrect.

discordResponseCodes.name: Too Many Requests
discordResponseCodes.description: The request was rate limited because too many requests were sent too quickly.

discordResponseCodes.name: Internal Server Error
discordResponseCodes.description: A problem occurred on Discord's side.

discordResponseCodes.name: Bad Gateway
discordResponseCodes.description: A temporary Discord or upstream gateway problem occurred.

discordResponseCodes.name: Gateway Timeout
discordResponseCodes.description: Discord or an upstream service took too long to respond.
